vibe_rationale: Long-running independent farm festival with a loyal community and a curated, music-led line-up; a single scene, but calm and welcoming.
fit_notes: Independent music fans camping for four days on a farm, with a calm setting that suits a recovery or wellness space (age split not published). Eighty listed partners, a partnership page and contact email, so the route in is visible but competitive. US-based, so Australian activation would need a US partner.
